cities.name: Riga

interests.name: Old Town Culture 🎭
interests.description: Riga’s Old Town is a UNESCO gem filled with medieval streets, historic towers, and colorful squares. Perfect for slow walks, photography, and cozy cafés.

interests.name: Art Nouveau Architecture 🏛️
interests.description: Riga is one of Europe's capitals of Art Nouveau. Alberta iela and surrounding streets showcase ornate facades and decorative details unique to the city.

interests.name: Riverside Walks 🌊
interests.description: The Daugava river promenade offers wide open views, peaceful walks, and beautiful sunsets. A calm and refreshing escape from the busy center.

interests.name: Parks & Nature 🌿
interests.description: Riga is full of green spaces like Esplanade Park, Bastejkalna Park, and Kronvalda Park — perfect for relaxing, reading, and nature strolls.

interests.name: Local Food Exploration 😋
interests.description: Traditional Latvian food includes veggie soups, potatoes, rye bread, and pastries. Riga Central Market offers authentic snacks and real local culture.

cities.local_food_tip: Latvian comfort food means veggie soups, potatoes, beet dishes, rye bread and pastries — simple, warm and satisfying.
cities.full_day: Morning: Start in Riga Old Town → see the exterior of House of the Blackheads → enjoy a cozy café. Afternoon: Walk through the Art Nouveau District (Alberta iela) → relax in Esplanade Park → lunch with soups, potatoes, salads → view the exterior of Latvian National Museum of Art. Sunset: Walk the Daugava Riverside Promenade. Night: Lantern-lit Old Town stroll + dessert bars.

places.name: Riga Old Town (Vecrīga)
places.description: The historic heart of Riga with medieval streets, historic buildings, and lively squares. Perfect for exploring on foot and absorbing Baltic charm.

places.name: House of the Blackheads
places.description: One of the most iconic buildings in Riga — beautifully reconstructed with ornate Gothic details. A must-see landmark in the main square.

places.name: Riga Cathedral
places.description: A monumental cathedral known for its architecture and famous organ. The surrounding square has a peaceful, historic atmosphere.

places.name: St. Peter’s Church
places.description: A striking Gothic church offering some of the best viewpoints in the city from its tower. Beautiful inside and out.

places.name: Art Nouveau District (Alberta iela)
places.description: The most famous Art Nouveau street in Riga, filled with beautifully decorated facades and architectural masterpieces.

places.name: Esplanade Park
places.description: A peaceful city park surrounded by major museums and churches. Ideal for resting between walks.

places.name: Latvian National Museum of Art
places.description: Riga’s main art museum with classic and modern exhibitions. Stunning building, especially its grand staircase hall.

places.name: Daugava Riverside Promenade
places.description: A scenic walkway along the Daugava River with open views, benches, and calm sunset atmosphere.

hidden_gems.name: Jacob’s Barracks (Jēkaba kazarmas)
hidden_gems.description: A colorful row of historic buildings slightly off the main tourist path. Cozy cafés and quiet corners.

hidden_gems.name: Wandering Street Murals
hidden_gems.description: Riga has vibrant street art in certain side streets — creative, surprising, and great for urban photography.

hidden_gems.name: Bastejkalna Park
hidden_gems.description: A romantic park with bridges, canals, and greenery right beside Old Town. Beautiful in every season.

🚶‍♂️ Art Nouveau walks along Alberta iela.

🚌 Buses cover all districts including outer neighborhoods.
🚶 Old Town is fully walkable and compact.

cities.name: Daugavpils

interests.name: Fortresses & History 🏰
interests.description: Daugavpils is home to one of the largest 19th-century fortresses in Northern Europe. The massive walls, open courtyards, and wide defensive zones create a unique historical landscape. Visitors can explore old military paths, exhibitions, and peaceful fortress squares. It's the city’s signature landmark and a must-see.

interests.name: Riverside Views 🌊
interests.description: The Daugava River gives the city serene waterside viewpoints perfect for slow walks and sunsets. Locals come for peaceful relaxation, photography, and scenic river breezes. The long promenade is ideal for an easy afternoon route. A calm contrast to the urban center.

interests.name: Local Culture 🎭
interests.description: Daugavpils blends Latvian, Polish, Russian, and Baltic influences into a culturally rich atmosphere. The city center has theaters, galleries, cafés, and open squares. Cultural traces appear everywhere — from architecture to markets to public art. A great place to experience everyday Baltic life.

cities.local_food_tip: Simple Baltic dishes — warm soups, potatoes, rye bread, beet salads, and pastries.
cities.full_day: Morning: Explore Daugavpils Fortress → walk the Daugava River Promenade → stop for coffee. Afternoon: Visit the exterior of Mark Rothko Art Center → lunch with soups and salads → easy stroll through City Center. Sunset: Enjoy river viewpoints along the Daugava. Night: Calm evening walk through peaceful city streets.

places.name: Daugavpils Fortress
places.description: A massive 19th-century fortification — walls, gates, courtyards, and quiet paths. One of Latvia’s most impressive historical complexes.

places.name: Mark Rothko Art Center
places.description: A modern art center dedicated to Mark Rothko, born in Daugavpils. Exhibits contemporary works and cultural programs.

places.name: Daugava Riverside Promenade
places.description: Beautiful riverwalk with benches, long paths, and calm waterside atmosphere. Great for sunsets.

places.name: Daugavpils City Center
places.description: Shops, cafés, squares, and daily local life. A compact central area easy to explore on foot.

places.name: Dubrovina Park
places.description: A peaceful park with sculptures, greenery, and quiet walking paths.

places.name: Daugavpils Synagogue
places.description: One of Latvia’s notable synagogues, representing the city’s multicultural heritage.

places.name: Martinson House
places.description: A ceramic art center dedicated to Pēteris Martinsons — Latvia’s famous ceramic artist.

places.name: Unity House (Vienības nams)
places.description: A cultural building with theater, events, and exhibitions — a key cultural landmark.

hidden_gems.name: Fortress Embankments
hidden_gems.description: Quiet walking routes along the outer walls of the fortress — great for photography and solitude.

hidden_gems.name: Esplanāde Forest Trails
hidden_gems.description: Natural trails just outside the central area — clean air and peaceful walking paths.

hidden_gems.name: Old Water Tower Viewpoint
hidden_gems.description: A lesser-known industrial landmark with unique atmosphere and photo potential.

cities.name: Jelgava

interests.name: Castles 🏰
interests.description: Jelgava Palace is one of Latvia’s most historically significant baroque buildings. Surrounded by water, it offers peaceful exterior views and scenic palace grounds.

interests.name: River Views 🌊
interests.description: The Lielupe river flows along Jelgava, creating relaxing walking paths, bridges, and open viewpoints perfect for sunset reflections and quiet walks.

interests.name: Local Culture 🎭
interests.description: Jelgava’s compact center includes small cafés, local shops, cultural spots and historical traces. Ideal for relaxed exploration after visiting the palace.

cities.local_food_tip: Veggie soups, potato dishes and warm pastries — simple and cozy Baltic comfort food.
cities.full_day: Morning: Visit the exterior of Jelgava Palace → walk along the Lielupe Riverside → café nearby. Afternoon: Explore Island Park (Post Island Park) → lunch with veggie dishes → stroll the Old Town. Sunset: Riverside golden-hour views. Night: Peaceful center lights and calm evening walk.

places.name: Jelgava Palace
places.description: A monumental baroque palace on an island between rivers. Beautiful exterior, peaceful grounds, and iconic views.

places.name: Lielupe Riverside Walk
places.description: A relaxing riverside promenade with viewpoints, benches and bridges — great for long peaceful walks.

places.name: Post Island Park (Pasta sala)
places.description: A quiet green island-park with walking paths, river views, and open spaces for relaxing afternoons.

places.name: Jelgava Old Town
places.description: A small but charming central area with cafés, historic corners, and local culture.

hidden_gems.name: Observation Tower on Pasta Island
hidden_gems.description: A wooden tower offering panoramic views over the rivers, palace and parks — especially beautiful at sunrise or sunset.

hidden_gems.name: Mitau Bridge Views
hidden_gems.description: A scenic pedestrian bridge with reflections of Jelgava Palace and the river — quiet and atmospheric.

🚌 Local buses cover all Jelgava districts.
🚶 The city center and palace area are walkable.

city_events.description: ❄️ A magical festival featuring frozen artworks, lights and winter creativity.

cities.name: Jūrmala

interests.name: Beaches 🌊
interests.description: Jūrmala is famous for its wide sandy beaches, gentle Baltic waves, and long waterfront paths. Majori Beach offers soft sand, scenic dunes, and relaxed seaside views.

interests.name: Pine Forests 🌿
interests.description: Pine forests stretch along the coastline, creating peaceful walking and cycling routes. Dzintari Forest Park blends nature with wooden paths and fresh sea air.

interests.name: Relaxed Coastal Streets 🎭
interests.description: Jomas Street is the lively heart of Jūrmala, filled with cafés, boutiques, and summer atmosphere. Great for slow strolls before or after beach time.

cities.local_food_tip: Fresh salads, veggie soups, pastries and seaside snacks — light and refreshing coastal food.
cities.full_day: Morning: Walk along Jomas Street → relax on Majori Beach → seaside café. Afternoon: Explore Dzintari Forest Park → light lunch → climb the Dzintari Viewing Tower. Sunset: Wide horizon views from the beach. Night: Calm evening stroll along the seaside promenade.

places.name: Majori Beach
places.description: The main beach of Jūrmala — wide, soft sand, perfect for swimming, sunbathing and sunset views.

places.name: Jomas Street
places.description: A lively pedestrian street with cafés and shops — atmospheric during summer and calm in the off-season.

places.name: Dzintari Forest Park
places.description: A pine-forest park with wooden paths, playgrounds, viewpoints, and peaceful natural surroundings.

places.name: Dzintari Viewing Tower
places.description: A tall wooden observation tower offering stunning views over pine forests, dunes, and the Baltic Sea.

hidden_gems.name: Ragakāpa Nature Park
hidden_gems.description: A coastal dune reserve with wooden trails, pine forests and beautiful quiet coastline — perfect for nature lovers.

hidden_gems.name: Dubulti Promenade
hidden_gems.description: A calmer, more peaceful part of the beach with a wide promenade and soft waves — ideal for morning or evening walks.

hidden_gems.name: Horned Beach (Raga Beach)
hidden_gems.description: A quieter, natural beach area away from the main tourist zones, great for solitude and undisturbed sea views.

cities.name: Liepāja

interests.name: Beaches 🌊
interests.description: Liepāja’s coastline is famous for its long sandy beaches and strong Baltic Sea breeze. The wide shore offers peaceful walks, beach relaxation, and dramatic sunsets. It’s a perfect escape for anyone who loves open horizons and fresh sea air.

interests.name: Fortresses 🏰
interests.description: Karosta Fortress and its surrounding military ruins are some of the most unique sites in Latvia. The area blends history, abandoned structures, and coastal views. It’s ideal for exploring, photography, and learning about the region’s past.

interests.name: Local Culture 🎭
interests.description: Liepāja is known as Latvia’s cultural capital, with theatres, street art, and creative neighborhoods. The city blends seaside calm with artistic expression. Perfect for travelers who enjoy music, performances, and vibrant local life.

cities.local_food_tip: Veggie-friendly coastal meals: light soups, salads, dark rye bread and pastries — simple, Baltic and warm.
cities.full_day: Morning: Relax on Liepāja Beach → enjoy Baltic sea breeze → morning coffee near the shore. Afternoon: Explore Karosta Fortress (exterior) → light lunch in town → discover Liepāja’s street art. Sunset: Watch golden colors along the beach viewpoint. Night: Calm stroll along the seaside promenade.

places.name: Liepāja Beach
places.description: A long sandy Baltic beach perfect for walking, sunbathing, and enjoying refreshing winds.

places.name: Karosta Fortress
places.description: A historic military area with fortress ruins, bunkers, and dramatic seaside viewpoints.

places.name: Karosta Breakwater (Northern Pier)
places.description: A massive pier stretching into the Baltic Sea — extremely atmospheric in windy weather.

places.name: Liepāja Theatre
places.description: One of the oldest theatres in the Baltics, representing the city’s cultural heart.

hidden_gems.name: Karosta Prison
hidden_gems.description: A former military prison turned into a unique museum — eerie, historic and unlike anything else in Latvia.

hidden_gems.name: Beberliņi Recreation Park
hidden_gems.description: A calm area with forest paths, lakeside spots, and peaceful surroundings.

hidden_gems.name: Redan Fortifications
hidden_gems.description: Old military defensive structures hidden in the forest — atmospheric and great for exploring.

cities.name: Valmiera

interests.name: Nature 🌿
interests.description: Valmiera is surrounded by the beautiful Gauja River valley, offering forest paths, river viewpoints, and peaceful green spaces. Ideal for nature walks, biking, and quiet exploration. The natural landscape is one of the city's biggest highlights.

interests.name: Local Culture 🎭
interests.description: Valmiera has a strong cultural identity centered around its historic theatre and creative community. The old-town area blends wooden architecture, cafés, and local arts. Perfect for travelers who enjoy slower, authentic cultural experiences.

interests.name: River Views 🌊
interests.description: The Gauja River provides calm viewpoints, scenic walking trails, and quiet riverside relaxation. It’s especially beautiful at sunset when the water reflects warm colors of the sky.

cities.local_food_tip: Light soups, salads, vegetable dishes and pastries — simple and cozy Baltic flavors.
cities.full_day: Morning: Walk through Gauja River Park → enjoy riverside viewpoints → coffee at a nearby café. Afternoon: Explore the historic center → light lunch → browse small craft shops. Sunset: Watch reflections along the Gauja River. Night: Enjoy calm evening walks through Valmiera’s quiet streets.

places.name: Gauja River Park
places.description: A peaceful green area along the river with walking paths, benches, and nature views.

places.name: Valmiera Old Town
places.description: Historic streets, local shops, and small-town charm — perfect for slow strolls.

places.name: Valmiera Theatre
places.description: One of Latvia’s most respected theatres and a cultural symbol of the city.

places.name: Gauja Riverside Viewpoints
places.description: Beautiful river views ideal for photography, meditation, or peaceful walks.

hidden_gems.description: A quiet park with water views and forest paths — loved by locals for relaxation.

hidden_gems.description: A countryside-style area with walking paths, a cultural yard, and traditional local food spots.

hidden_gems.name: Steep Gauja Riverbank Trails
hidden_gems.description: Short but scenic forest trails along the river with elevated viewpoints.
